_comment: Project-scoped MCP server config for Claude Code (M42). Claude Code asks before enabling a
project server, so checking this in offers the bridge to anyone working in the repo without
turning it on behind their back.
This form runs the server straight out of the checkout, so it needs the MCP SDK in whatever
python resolves to:  pip install -r requirements-mcp.txt  (or requirements-dev.txt, which
already carries it). To use the bridge from OUTSIDE this repo, install it instead --
pipx install .  -- and point `command` at the `klarpdf-mcp` script pipx puts on PATH.
See mcp_bridge/README.md for that and for the Claude Desktop equivalents.
